Campaign angle notes:
- Four angles are legally approved: price cut (A), quality story (B), limited-time urgency (C), customer testimonial (D).
- Tested B and D only; A and C have not been tested.
- Results are aggregated and do not identify performance by day or angle. Day 5 reported 2 of the previous 5 pushes landed; Day 10 reported 4 of the previous 5 landed. Do not claim B or D caused either result.
- B and D are both trust/value-oriented and avoid discounting or pressure; continue testing them if brand safety and durable value are priorities.
- No deliverability complaints observed. Some days had two support-reported unsubscribes; they were processed, but there is insufficient evidence linking them to a particular angle.
- The list recently gained a handful of signups; refreshed banner art is available.
- Send window is normally 10am.
- Next decisions should rotate or compare B and D deliberately, and eventually test A/C if learning about price and urgency is useful. Track angle-level outcomes rather than relying on overlapping “last five” reports.

Campaign angle notes:
- All four angles are legally approved: price cut (A), quality story (B), limited-time urgency (C), and customer testimonial (D).
- Testing to date has focused on B and D. Recent sequence: D on Days 11, 17, and 18; B on Days 12–16, 19, and 20. A and C remain untested.
- Reports are aggregated and overlap the prior five pushes; they provide no day- or angle-level attribution. Day 15 reported 2 of the previous 5 pushes landed; Day 20 reported 4 of the previous 5. Do not claim B or D caused either result.
- B and D remain trust/value-oriented and avoid discounting or pressure. Continue deliberate B/D comparisons if brand safety and durable value are priorities; test A/C when learning about price or urgency is useful.
- Track every push by angle with comparable metrics; do not rely on “last five” summaries for causal conclusions.
- No deliverability complaints observed. Support reported two unsubscribes on multiple days; they were processed, but there is insufficient evidence linking them to any angle.
- The list gained a handful of signups. Refreshed banner art is available, but creative changes may confound comparisons, so record them with each send.
- Normal send window is 10am.

Campaign angle notes:
- All four angles remain legally approved: price cut (A), quality story (B), limited-time urgency (C), and customer testimonial (D).
- Testing history now includes B on Day 21; A on Days 22, 24, 25, 28, 29, and 30; and D on Days 23, 26, and 27. C remains untested.
- Recent reports are pooled over the prior five pushes and provide no day- or angle-level attribution. Day 25 reported 0 of the previous 5 pushes landed; Day 30 reported 2 of the previous 5. Do not attribute either result to A, B, or D, including the reported +0.40 outcome on Day 30.
- Continue logging every send by angle with comparable metrics. Use deliberate B/D comparisons for trust and durable-value learning; use A/C when learning about price or urgency is useful. Avoid causal conclusions from “last five” summaries.

- The list gained a handful of signups before Day 22; record audience-size changes alongside results.
- Support reported two unsubscribes on Days 23 and 27; they were processed, but there is insufficient evidence linking them to any angle.
- No deliverability complaints observed. Normal send window is 10am.

Campaign angle notes:
- All four angles remain legally approved: price cut (A), quality story (B), limited-time urgency (C), and customer testimonial (D).
- Testing history: B on Days 21, 31–34, and 36–39; A on Days 22, 24, 25, 28–30; D on Days 23, 26, and 27; C on Days 35 and 40. B has been heavily repeated recently; D remains the clearest underused comparator, and C has only two tests.
- Reports are pooled over the prior five pushes and provide no day- or angle-level attribution. Day 25 reported 0/5 landed; Day 30 reported 2/5; Days 35 and 40 each reported 1/5. Do not attribute these outcomes to any angle, including C’s +0.20 results or Day 30’s +0.40.
- Continue logging every send with angle, comparable engagement/conversion metrics, banner/creative status, audience size, and normal 10am timing. Use deliberate B/D comparisons for trust and durable-value learning; use A/C when price or urgency learning is useful.
- Refreshed banner art was introduced before Days 21, 26, 34, and 38. Treat creative changes as potential confounders.
- The list gained handfuls of signups before Day 22 and on Days 36 and 39; record audience-size changes with results.
- Support reported/processsed two unsubscribes on multiple days (23, 27, 32, 33, 35, 37, and 40). Track them separately; there is insufficient evidence linking them to any angle.
- No deliverability complaints observed.

Campaign angle notes:
- All four angles remain legally approved: price cut (A), quality story (B), limited-time urgency (C), and customer testimonial (D).
- Testing history through Day 50: B on Days 21, 31–34, 36–39; A on Days 22, 24, 25, 28–30; D on Days 23, 26–27, and 41–49; C on Days 35 and 40. D is no longer an underused comparator and has now been heavily repeated. C remains lightly tested.
- Reports are pooled over the prior five pushes and provide no day- or angle-level attribution. Day 45 reported 4/5 landed; Day 50 reported 0/5. Do not attribute either result to D or any other angle. Earlier pooled outcomes and reported lifts likewise cannot establish angle performance.
- Avoid further consecutive D sends; use deliberate B/D or A/C comparisons with enough repetition for interpretable learning. Select A or C when price/urgency learning is specifically needed.
- Log every send with angle, comparable engagement/conversion metrics, banner/creative status, audience size, and normal 10am timing. Record engagement, conversions, deliverability, and unsubscribes separately.
- Refreshed banner art was introduced before Days 21, 26, 34, and 38, and again overnight before Day 42. Treat creative changes as potential confounders.
- The list gained signups before Day 22 and on Days 36 and 39; continue recording audience-size changes.
- Support reported/processed two unsubscribes on multiple days (23, 27, 32, 33, 35, 37, and 40). No evidence links them to any angle.
- No deliverability complaints observed.

Campaign angle notes:
- All four angles remain legally approved: price cut (A), quality story (B), limited-time urgency (C), and customer testimonial (D).
- Through Day 50, D had already been heavily repeated; C was lightly tested. Days 51–60 then used C exclusively, making C heavily repeated and creating no clean comparison with other angles.
- Pooled reports remain non-diagnostic: Day 55 reported 0/5 landed and Day 60 reported 2/5. Neither result can be attributed to C or any individual day. Do not infer angle performance from pooled reports.
- Avoid further consecutive C sends. Resume deliberate comparisons, such as B/C or A/C, with enough repetition and stable creative to learn. Use A or C when price/urgency learning is specifically needed; otherwise rotate to B or D.
- Log every send with angle, audience size, engagement, conversions, deliverability, unsubscribes, banner/creative status, and normal 10am timing. Keep engagement, conversions, deliverability, and unsubscribes separate.
- Refreshed banner art occurred before Days 21, 26, 34, 38, 42, 52, 56, and 60. Treat creative changes as confounders; avoid drawing conclusions from sends immediately around refreshes.
- The list gained signups before Day 22, on Days 36 and 39, and around Day 59; continue recording audience-size changes.
- Support processed two unsubscribes on multiple earlier days and again on Days 55 and 57. Do not attribute them to C or any other angle.
- No deliverability complaints observed.
